name: images
description: Draws images inline in the terminal transcript: pixels where Claude Code draws kitty graphics, half-block cells elsewhere.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: pixels where Claude Code draws kitty graphics, half-blocks elsewhere. image: always the kitty Image. halfblock: always half-block cells.

showPathsInReplies.title: Show paths in replies
showPathsInReplies.description: Draw an image a reply names by a bare absolute or ~/ path, not only as a markdown image.

steerToSendUserFile.title: Steer to SendUserFile
steerToSendUserFile.description: Add a short system-prompt section, in the terminal only, telling Claude this terminal draws images and that SendUserFile is how to show one when asked.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Picture size against one screen pixel per image pixel: 1 shows images at their own size, 2 doubles them, 0.5 halves them. Pictures still fit the transcript width and 60% of its height, and none is narrower than 24 columns. From 0.25 to 4.

showCaptions.title: Show captions
showCaptions.description: Under each picture, its file name (a link to the file where there is one), its size in pixels, and the percentage it is shown at.
